## Full report

Test window **2025-10-06 → 2026-11-18** (280 sessions), 300 Shariah (KMI All Share) stocks, scored with the production scorer on the history available each day.
"Excess" = the group's average return minus the average Shariah stock (same liquidity filter) over the same days. "Beat" = share of picks that did better than that average. Costs not deducted (≈0.3–0.5% round trip on PSX).

## Limits

- Shariah membership is today's list, so stocks that dropped out of KMI All Share are missing (survivorship bias, usually flatters results).
- Picks on consecutive days overlap heavily, so the n's overstate independent evidence; month-by-month consistency is the fairer read.
- One period of PSX history: it can reject a rule, not prove one. Thresholds were fixed before running, not tuned to this output.
- The live scanner also adds news-flagged sectors and an AI narrative; neither is replayed here.
